title: The engineering budget: cloud, tooling, licences and people

videos.script: Ask an engineer what engineering costs, and you will usually hear about the cloud bill. {{title}} It is the one invoice everybody sees. At Coreto it is two hundred and twelve thousand reais a month. It is also a small part of the money. Seventy-nine percent of Coreto's engineering budget is people. {{people}} So when the CFO asks for ten percent back, the arithmetic is quick and uncomfortable. Ten percent is six point six engineers. Or sixty-eight percent of the whole cloud bill. {{cut}} This lesson puts the whole budget on one sheet in your spreadsheet. It shows what a cut really means, and how to say so out loud before somebody decides it by accident. {{sheet}} Then it turns the other way. Davi needs money for the team that will fix the seat holds. You will see him write that request in the units a finance reader uses. A line, an amount, a date, and what comes back. {{ask}}
